name: bread
description: BREAD — the umbrella for the stack: batch · grain · mill · proof as submodules, plus the project-wide plans board (PANTRY-hosted).
author: Tjakoen Stolk <tjakoen.s@gmail.com> (https://tjakoen.github.io)

scripts.deps:refresh: for p in batch grain mill proof standards pantry; do bun add -d @tjakoen/$p@github:tjakoen/$p#$(git ls-remote https://github.com/tjakoen/$p.git main | cut -c1-7); done

//devDependencies: Every @tjakoen github spec in the graph is pinned DIRECTLY, not only pantry: bun 1.3.14's transitive github resolution races and fails intermittently (the bigger the graph, the more often); direct specs resolve reliably and satisfy the transitive ones. Keep the five layer pins matched to pantry's own pins — deps:refresh re-pins all six.
